prompt: Run a component-state repair through component-states, form-ux where inputs are involved, a11y-pass, deslop-ui, humanize-copy where copy is changed, and tastecheck-pass. Skip absent subjects only with explicit reasons.
assertions: Each handoff names its evidence fields and preserves semantic tokens.
Absent skills are skipped with subject-absence reasons, never assumed executed.
Tastecheck-pass fails if any required evidence is missing or dishonest.
The final gate report distinguishes canonical rows from presentation treatment.
Command wrappers route to the matching skill and retain its stop conditions; the canonical evidence fields remain stable while presentation structure and voice may vary.

Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across structure, aesthetic treatment, or voice and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
Negative routing is explicit at every handoff: name the rejected adjacent skill, the absent or out-of-scope subject, and the receiving boundary.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: Every specialist handoff must explicitly reject the adjacent skill when its subject is absent or out of scope.
